metadata.name: sealed_launchpad
metadata.description: Sealed-Block Launchpad with Fee-Credit Buyback Vault

accounts.name: treasury_quote
docs: Treasury quote token account (receives the no-reveal slash).

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: New launch token mint (fresh keypair, signs). 6 decimals, mint authority = mint_authority PDA, no freeze authority.

accounts.name: buyback_vault
docs: Non-withdrawable buyback vault: authority = launch PDA; only execute_buyback_drip moves funds out.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may submit the reveal (bidder or the auto-reveal relayer).

errors.name: InvalidAuctionSupply
errors.msg: Auction supply must be 20%..60% of supply

errors.name: RevealWindowNotOpen
errors.msg: Reveal window is not open yet

errors.name: CommitmentMismatch
errors.msg: Commitment does not match revealed preimage

errors.name: InvalidTick
errors.msg: Price is not a valid tick

errors.name: SniperIneligible
errors.msg: Wallet is a same-slot sniper and is ineligible

errors.name: InvalidStatus
errors.msg: Launch is not in the required status

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

types.name: BidCommitted
docs: Only public escrow aggregates — never individual bid sizes/prices.

fields.name: vault
docs: Token account PDA ["credit_vault", quote_mint], authority = this CreditPool PDA.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: Program-only: rewards settled on stake/unstake but not yet transferred.

fields.name: pool_quote_seeded
docs: Quote atoms actually moved escrow → pool at graduation (total_raised minus per-bid rounding buffer).

types.name: LaunchStatus
docs: On-chain LaunchStatus (u8). Matches ONCHAIN_STATUS in program.ts.
